title: Document Permission Filter
summary: Filter retrieval chunks by public, tenant, group, and private permissions before ranking.
starterCode: def filter_chunks(chunks: list[dict], user: dict, k: int) -> list[str]:

testCases.name: allows public and matching-tenant chunks
testCases.description: Public chunks and chunks with matching tenant IDs are authorized.
testCases.feedback: Authorize chunks with public visibility or identical non-null tenant identifiers.

testCases.name: allows a matching tenant group
testCases.description: Group-scoped chunks require matching tenant and at least one shared group.
testCases.feedback: Verify tenant match and non-empty intersection between chunk groups and user groups.

testCases.name: allows a private chunk only for its owner
testCases.description: Private chunks are accessible only when chunk owner matches user ID.
testCases.feedback: Match private chunk owner with user ID, requiring non-null identities for both.

testCases.name: ranks score ties by id and applies k
testCases.description: Visible chunks are sorted by score descending, breaking ties alphabetically by ID, limited to k.
testCases.feedback: Sort by score descending then chunk ID ascending, and return at most k items.

testCases.name: denies malformed or unknown visibility
testCases.description: Chunks with missing, unrecognized, non-string, or non-matching group visibility are denied.
testCases.feedback: Fail closed on missing or unexpected visibility attributes by omitting the chunk.

testCases.name: public zero limit returns no chunks
testCases.description: A zero result limit returns an empty selection.
testCases.feedback: Apply k after authorization and ranking; a zero slice is empty.

testCases.name: private group access also requires tenant match
testCases.description: Shared group membership never crosses tenant boundaries.
testCases.feedback: Check tenant equality before group overlap.

testCases.name: filtering leaves input unchanged
testCases.description: Ranking visible chunks must not reorder the source list.
testCases.feedback: Sort a filtered copy and preserve the input list.

testCases.name: empty chunks returns empty list
testCases.description: An empty candidate list returns an empty list.
testCases.feedback: Handle empty chunk input gracefully without errors.

testCases.name: negative limit returns empty list
testCases.description: A negative result limit returns no rows.
testCases.feedback: Treat every non-positive limit as an empty result before slicing.

testCases.name: tenant chunk missing tenant is denied
testCases.description: Tenant-scoped chunks with missing tenant attributes are denied.
testCases.feedback: Ensure tenant-scoped chunks have a valid non-null tenant attribute that matches the user.

testCases.name: missing tenant identity denies protected chunks
testCases.description: A protected chunk with no tenant identity must not match a user with no tenant identity.
testCases.feedback: Require non-null tenant identities before comparing tenant-scoped access.

testCases.name: missing owner identity denies private chunks
testCases.description: A private chunk with no owner must not match a user with no ID.
testCases.feedback: Require non-null owner and user ID before allowing private access.

testCases.name: permission gate precedes top k truncation
null user groups deny group but private uses global ownership

clarifyingQuestions: Should private documents also require tenant match?
Should group visibility require tenant match as well as group overlap?
Should final ranking preserve retriever order or sort by score?
followUps: Add deny rules that override allow rules.
Attach reasons for filtered chunks for audit.
Enforce permissions before fetching chunk text.
followUpGuide: Deny rules must run before allow rules or explicitly override them.
Audit reasons are useful but should not leak document content.
Filtering IDs before loading text reduces accidental data exposure.
complexityAnalysis: - Supplied filter then sort: with n candidates, u user groups, G total chunk-group entries examined, and v authorized rows. Time: O(n + u + G + v log v) expected with hash sets, treating string operations/comparisons as bounded. Space: O(v + u + g), where g is the largest examined chunk-group list; output is at most min(k,v). User groups are built once.

- Indexed authorization follow-up: permission-aware retrieval can reduce candidates examined, but complexity depends on index/query/ACL representation; no general O(k) bound follows from adding an index.

- Cached ACL follow-up: cached allowed-document sets speed membership checks but still require filtering candidates and ranking. Time: O(n + v log v) expected with bounded hash/string operations. Space: proportional to all cached subject-document grants plus O(v); revocation needs cache invalidation or an authoritative recheck.
solutionGuide: Treat unknown or missing visibility as denied. Rank only after filtering. Normalize missing or null group lists to empty lists.
